name: AI Retopo
description: Pick a mesh, Plugins > AI Retopo: it measures the mesh (tris, quads, holes, symmetry), builds a clean quad mesh at the polycount of the role (hero / npc / light / prop), bakes the texture to new UVs and brings the result back as '<name>_retopo'. Needs Blender (runs in the background). Auto quad flow is a stop-gap: joints / face / hands may still need hand retopo.
